notes: New: Simulator Publish: send the tournament videos to YouTube (long ones, and Shorts), Instagram Reels, TikTok and Facebook, one after another in play order. Edit every title and caption, space them out by hours or by each platform's daily limit, or post all now 5 minutes apart. TikTok and Facebook get a Ready to post folder on your PC. Sign-ins stay on your PC; Simulator: the Chosen One, a fast, sturdy arrow with weak hits. Every 4 hits it fires its next technique: Blue (a sphere that curves in and shoves you away), Red (a slow sphere that drags you around it) and Purple (it runs to the far edge, aims, and fires a thick beam you can dodge if you are quick); Simulator Sandbox: switch the video you are watching between Short and Long
